preconditions.description: The number of months n is between 2 and 500,000.
The length of the first half of the income list a is ⌈n/2⌉.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each income value in the first half is between -10^9 and 10^9.
The income value for the second half is between -10^9 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: return_value in range(1, n + 1) or return_value == -1
postconditions.description: The output is an integer k between 1 and n, or -1 if no such k exists.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(a[i:i+k]) > 0 for i in range(n - k + 1))
postconditions.description: For each k consecutive months, the total income is a profit.
